title: Implement atomic Photo and pending publication

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Atomic admission tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/inventory/test_atomic_admission.py

verify.summary: Fresh independent T2 verification passed both exact packaged-image gates. A verifier-owned PostgreSQL probe replayed success and real before-commit rollback twice, proving the same active caller Session through the public processing boundary, exactly one complete Photo/pending pair with exact linkage/defaults/server timestamps on success, zero new database admission on rollback, no foreign or later-scope ORM state, and complete task-owned cleanup.

The autopilot scheduler closed TASK-012 after Execution Attempt 1 earned fresh packaged-image T2 verification PASS for atomic Photo plus initial pending publication, real pre-commit rollback, exact linkage/defaults, owner-boundary use, replay safety and complete cleanup.

evidence_required: FT-001-AC-003 RED: the inventory admission operation cannot publish Photo and serving pending as one observable unit; GREEN: one valid unique staged candidate commits exactly one Photo with server accepted_at and exactly one serving pending row, while an injected pre-commit exception leaves neither row; decisive comparison: success is the complete pair and rollback is zero database admission; artifact: isolated PostgreSQL transaction test output and before/after row projection.
purpose: Implement the inventory-owned cross-slice transaction that atomically publishes one accepted Photo and its initial serving work.
success_outcome: A valid unique staged candidate is published by one short PostgreSQL transaction as exactly one Photo plus one serving pending state, or rollback leaves no database admission.
anti_goals: Do not implement duplicate outcome arbitration, pre-commit crash-window recovery, HTTP/UI behavior or later processing transitions.
Do not let inventory write processing-owned state directly or add distributed transaction machinery.

forbidden_scope: Duplicate outcome and candidate cleanup claim
stop_conditions: Photo and pending cannot share one short PostgreSQL transaction through the accepted processing boundary.
The outcome would require direct foreign repository writes or a distributed transaction.
Work expands into a sibling claim or changes the accepted admission transaction.

constraints: inventory owns orchestration and calls the processing initial-pending boundary inside the same caller transaction.
accepted_at and the pending state timestamp are server assigned inside the successful operation.
A synthetic non-secret uploader UUID is allowed only in isolated core tests before the public auth integration.
invariants: Observers see both Photo and serving pending, or neither.
The transaction creates no later processing state, searchable result, teaser or metric contribution beyond the accepted Photo identity.
Cross-slice state changes use only the named owner boundaries.
verification_targets: Isolated success and injected-rollback integration probes compare complete Photo/pending row sets and clean only task-owned state.
